hiddenSurfaces.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production hidden-surface underlay for an approved 2D sprite animation. Edit target is the supplied golden stone nest. Keep the same 512-square canvas registration, camera, exact rock silhouettes, all stone positions and dimensions, colors, facets, open cave, orange cave floor and ground contact. REMOVE ONLY all technology: wooden beam and bracket, pulley, every rope, raised horizontal hanging stone door, hanging counterweight and fittings. Restore the missing continuous golden stone arch surfaces and dark brown cave interior behind those removed objects. Keep the cap stone exactly in its place, keep the existing segmented arch, keep the two tiers of stones on either side and the foreground pebbles. Do not redesign or add stones. No ground plane or shadow outside the sprite. Genuine transparent background. This is a clean hidden backing layer; the original artwork will be overlaid to preserve every visible original pixel.
hiddenSurfaces.usage: backing behind native pulley, door, ropes and counterweight; native visible pixels retained
